title: Minacantalucio
import_instruction: Add canonical original title and ID to Mina catalog; keep as a separate LP from La Mina
edition_note: PDU PLD L 6036. Recorded and issued 1975, ten Battisti-Mogol songs; original boxed package may combine with La Mina; not a compilation of Mina recordings.

title: La Mina
import_instruction: Add 1975 album after Minacantalucio with ID mina-lamina
edition_note: PDU PLD L 6037. Ten tracks; frequently sold together with Minacantalucio but a distinct original LP. L’importante è finire is one song only.

title: Singolare
import_instruction: Add separate studio album under ID mina-singolare; do not create combined Singolare e plurale duplicate
edition_note: PDU PLD L 6067; original ten tracks and solo vocals; the 1976 twin-LP edition contains a separate second LP.

title: Plurale
import_instruction: Add separate album under ID mina-plurale; maintain chronological pair after Singolare
edition_note: PDU PLD L 6068; eleven tracks incl Intro and 8-second Good Evening Friends; all vocals are Mina multitracked, not a live choir.
